name: Brega

attributes.attribute: the rich region now in Co. Meath and parts of Co. Westmeath

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Brega is an Irish mythological site. The name also appears as Bregia. This great central plain appears in several ancient texts. It is believed to be the rich farming region that today is County Meath and parts of County Westmeath.

okr.objective: Describe Brega, the Irish mythological central plain.
key_results: Brega was an Irish mythological site.
The name also appears as Bregia.
It was a great central plain in ancient texts.
It is now Co. Meath and parts of Co. Westmeath.
